🧤 "Due to the severe ACL injury to #Grabara (who will be sidelined until April), #Juventus is evaluating the addition of #Neto as an 8-month emergency signing (until June 30).He would arrive as an experienced second goalkeeper alongside #Pinsoglio, while waiting to define the long-term situation.​The future of the juventino goal will depend heavily on whether they decide to permanently buy Guglielmo #Vicario (who is currently on loan).In parallel, #Juve keeps Lorenzo #Palmisani on its agenda, the young #Frosinone goalkeeper who is locked down until 2031.The club has been scouting him (including 2 recent visits this season) and views him as a solid candidate for the bianconero goal heading in

👀 "#Juventus sent their scouts to closely monitor the young Italian-Swiss midfielder, born in 2006, Alessandro #Romano, having watched him in person on two occasions this season.Given #Juve's need to make future reinforcements in the midfield, #Romano is shaping up to be one of the names to watch in the upcoming mercato windows."[@NicoSchira on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

MEDICAL UPDATE | KOLO MUANIDuring the first half of Sunday's match against Atalanta, Randal Kolo Muani sustained an injury to the fifth finger of his right hand. Tests carried out after the match revealed a fracture of the proximal phalanx, making osteosynthesis surgery necessary.The operation, performed this afternoon by Dr Loris Pegoli at J|medical, was completely successful and the player will remain available for selection.[Juventus]

🇹🇷 #Juventus is evaluating the addition of a highly experienced and top quality organizing midfielder.Among the profiles being considered is Hakan #Çalhanoğlu, for whom an exploratory inquiry would have already taken place.The Turk, whose contract with #Inter runs until 2027, will first speak with the nerazzurro club to discuss the renewal.In the event that an agreement is not reached, #Juve could become a concrete option to pursue.[@_Morik92_ - @TUTTOJUVE_COM via @PuebloJ]
